verdict.rationale: Mintlify gives several non-production test surfaces. The CLI previews docs locally and catches build errors before production deploys [11]. Each pull request gets a unique preview URL so changes can be reviewed live before merging [17][12]. The REST API can create or update preview deployments for a branch, which supports agent-driven workflows [49]. Agent edits also land as pull requests for review rather than going straight to the live site [4]. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test mode for the write-capable admin MCP server and REST API, sandbox credentials separate from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration that previews are fully isolated from live data.
